verification_attempts.finding: Gateway hostname and routing are valid; current RapidAPI account/key is not subscribed to SandboxAPI.

runtime_verification_rule: Do not mark RUNTIME_VERIFIED until an actual remote execute call returns exit_code=0 and expected sentinel output through the RapidAPI gateway.
claycode_uses_when_verified: build real ClayCode parsers and compilers
capture compiler/runtime failures as research evidence
claycode_learning_rule: Every nontrivial SandboxAPI ClayCode execution must emit a durable executable-research receipt containing source/semantic hashes, compiler version, sandbox/runtime identity, test cases, stdout/stderr/exit status, timings when returned, failures/counterexamples, interpretation, and affected hypotheses. New compiler/runtime learnings must be fed back into ClayCode hypotheses, negative results and the seven-branch mesh rather than remaining only in logs.
authority_boundary: Sandbox execution is research evidence only. It cannot promote a ClayCode candidate, change canonical truth, or grant external capabilities without normal RAE evidence/promotion gates.
